hooks.prompt: Before the user edits this file, check if there are any conflicts with neo_check_conflicts MCP tool. Extract the file_path from the tool input and use it to check for conflicts. Return the conflict status to inform the user, but don't block the edit.

After the user edits a file, automatically log the activity using neo_log_activity MCP tool. Extract the file_path and infer a brief intent from the edit context. Use agent_id 'claude-code' and mark as work in progress.
